resources.string: Maps, library, assistant and radio available offline
Choose where to store the data.
The services are not responding. Try again; if it persists, check the logs in the data folder (logs).
Survivelia OS stopped several times. Logs in %1$s
Where should maps, books and data be stored?
microSD card or USB drive «%1$s» (SurvivalOS folder)
App folder on the microSD card
kept if you uninstall the app
Android deletes it if you uninstall the app
To store the data in the SurvivalOS folder (so it is not lost if you uninstall the app), turn on «Allow access to all files» for Survivelia OS on the next screen and go back.
Without that permission this folder cannot be used. Choose another one (the app folder needs no permission, but Android deletes it on uninstall).
Survivelia OS uses the tablet\'s GNSS receiver to show your position on the map and record tracks, without Internet. Your location never leaves the device.
Keep working with the screen off

So that downloads, radio and GPS do not stop with the screen off, let Survivelia OS run without battery restrictions. On some brands (Realme, Xiaomi, Huawei…) also check «Auto-launch» and «Background activity» in the app settings.
To install the new version, Android needs you to allow Survivelia OS to install apps. Turn it on in the next screen and go back: the installer will open by itself.
Knowledge, maps and communication without Internet
Waiting for the “%1$s” card with your data…
The “%1$s” card, where your data is (%2$s), cannot be found. Check that it is inserted properly: Survivelia OS will start by itself as soon as it appears. You can also choose another folder.
The “All files access” permission is needed to use your data in %1$s. Grant it again (your data is still there) or choose another folder.
Your maps, books and downloads stay in %1$s: they are not moved or deleted, and you can switch back to that folder at any time. The new one starts empty.
